slots.metaTitle: Custom Jujutsu Kaisen Portrait From Your Photo
slots.metaDescription: Order a hand-drawn Jujutsu Kaisen portrait from $39.99. See your preview within 72 hours, with unlimited free revisions. Start your portrait today.
slots.description: ["Turn your photo into an original sorcerer-style character with a hand-drawn custom Jujutsu Kaisen portrait from Anime Cabinet. Human artists interpret your features through a dark modern shonen visual language: crisp angular linework, high-contrast shadows, dramatic perspective, cool palettes, and swirling cursed-energy effects. Your cheekbones, eye spacing, nose bridge, hairstyle, and expression remain recognisably yours while the finished artwork gives you the intensity of a special-grade character. This is fan-art inspired design, not a copy or impersonation of a copyrighted character.","Choose a serious stare, a confident smirk, or a full team composition with friends, family, or a partner. You can request back-to-back poses, contrasting energy colours, sorcerer-uniform details, dramatic lighting, or a subtle domain-expansion atmosphere. Dark clothing often blends beautifully into the shadows, while a clear, well-lit reference photo helps the artist capture your face accurately. Include your preferred mood, pose, colour direction, background, and any technique-inspired ideas in the order notes. For groups, upload a photo for each person and explain how you want everyone arranged.","Every portrait is drawn by a human artist rather than produced by an AI filter. You receive a preview within 72 hours, and unlimited free revisions are included so the expression, hairstyle, energy effects, and composition can be refined until the result feels like you. Order a digital artwork for wallpapers, profiles, or gifts, or select a custom anime portrait canvas for your wall. The price starts at $39.99, with the final cost depending on your chosen format and number of people. For more inspiration, explore our [Jujutsu Kaisen-inspired custom poster guide](/blog/jujutsu-kaisen-inspired-custom-poster), browse [gift ideas for Jujutsu Kaisen fans](/blog/best-gifts-for-jujutsu-kaisen-fans), or compare the [Naruto portrait style](/portraits/naruto) and other options from [Anime Cabinet](/)."]
